title: R_5(3(x-y)=2z) > 368: checked five-colour frontier bound
statement: The 5-colour Rado number of 3(x-y) = 2z exceeds 368. Exact web, arXiv, and Scholar-oriented searches through 2026-08-26 located no prior five-colour bound at least 368 for this equation; this is dated negative retrieval evidence, not proof of priority. The bound also establishes that this work's shell construction, which gives 319 at (a,k)=(3,5), is NOT TIGHT at k=5 -- in contrast to k=3 and k=4, where it is attained at every point tested.

prior_art.establishes: R_3 and partial R_4 tables for this family. No k=5 values; their Lemma 4.2 (the b=a-1 construction) is stated for k=3 only.

prior_art.citation: A. C. Li, 'On Rado Numbers for x+by=bz: The b^k Pattern and a Threshold Conjecture', SSRN 6814341 (2026)
prior_art.establishes: Reports R_5(3) > 296 > 243 in the b=1 column, i.e. non-tightness of the a^k law at k=5. Not peer-reviewed; full text not read (paywalled). Our independent finding is the b=a-1 analogue.

evidence.notes: A deterministic least-available-colour extension carries the checked 358-point witness through 368, appending colours 4,1,3,1,2,3,3,2,4,3. Axeyum's direct verifier enumerated all 29,890 defining triples; a separately constructed complete assignment also satisfied all 154,967 clauses of the canonical 1,840-variable CNF and decoded to this byte-identical witness. Every colour is locally blocked at 369 for this fixed prefix, but that is not an upper bound.

A historical 5-colouring of [358] obtained by appending colour 4 to the checked 357-point witness. Axeyum's direct verifier enumerated all 28,322 defining triples; a separately constructed complete assignment also satisfied all 146,977 clauses of the canonical 1,790-variable CNF and decoded to this byte-identical witness. A deterministic extension yields the stronger retained 368-point witness.

A historical 5-colouring of [357] using all five colours, with no monochromatic solution among all 28,203 defining triples. CaDiCaL seed 619 found the model on the canonical 1,785-variable / 146,367-clause instance; Axeyum's strict model import and this independent direct relation enumerator both replayed it. Appending colour 4 yields the stronger retained 358-point witness.

A 5-colouring of [350] using all five colours, no monochromatic solution among the 27,028 solution triples. Reached by incremental climbing from the verified 319 witness, one integer at a time with warm restarts; the climb stalled at 351, so 350 is the search's limit rather than a proven threshold.

evidence.supports: R_5 > 319 (lower bound, strictly exceeding the construction's bound of 319)
evidence.notes: A 5-colouring of [319] using all five colours, with no monochromatic solution among the 22,472 solution triples in [319]^2. Verified by axeyum's own model self-check and by an independent brute-force enumerator sharing no code with the generator.

known: R_5(3(x-y)=2z) > 368, witnessed and verified (evidence row witness-368); the earlier 358, 357, 350, and 319 witnesses are retained as reproducibility and historical frontier points

The shell construction of this work yields a verified solution-free colouring of [N] with N+1 = a^k + a^(k-1) - 2a + 1; this is ATTAINED at (a,k)=(3,3) [31], (4,3) [73], (3,4) [103] and (4,4) [313], all independently re-verified, but NOT at (3,5), where it gives 318 while a 5-colouring of [319] exists. The general-k proof is asserted in the construction source and has NOT been independently verified here.
Independent corroboration of k=5 non-tightness in a different column: Li (SSRN 6814341) reports R_5(3)>296>243 for b=1

Canonical exact instances 351 through 357 are SAT and replayed; deterministic checked extension reaches 368; every colour is locally blocked at 369 for this fixed prefix, but instance 369 remains open
frontier.would_settle: A verified 5-colouring of [n-1] together with an exhaustive cube cover refuting [n], for the same n. Both artifact kinds and their checkers exist in this family; the obstruction is the cost of refutation at k=5, not the encoding.
frontier.attack_notes: The satisfiable side reaches 368: exact solving produced the 357 witness, then deterministic new-relation audits and two complete replay routes extended it through 368. The fixed prefix does not extend directly to 369; the refutation side remains unclosed and is the real exact-value question.

notes: Recorded because a failed prediction is evidence. The construction's bound remains SOUND -- a lower bound cannot be refuted by finding a larger colouring -- but its tightness, which holds at k=3 and k=4, does not extend to k=5. This is the datum that scopes every tightness claim in this work to k <= 4.
